assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / background-extraction.
Asset type: a single transparent PNG ornament for an e-ink ebook bookshelf UI, part of a matched pair of modernist author busts.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and likeness reference: Marjorie Fitzgibbon's bronze bust of James Joyce, photographed by Illustratedjc. Preserve the recognizable head, round spectacles, nose, moustache, swept-back hair, thoughtful expression, jacket lapels and bow tie of THIS sculpture, not a generic classical man.
Transform this into a refined small light-plaster shelf ornament. Remove every bit of the park, trees, sky, tall inscribed monument, and other surroundings. Retain the bust only, rematerialized as matte warm ivory plaster with restrained carved planes, subtle soft surface texture, clear medium-gray recesses and dark-gray spectacle outlines. Mount it on one low, plain, rectangular light-stone plinth with a beveled top edge, about 12% of total object height and just wider than the shoulders. No text, inscription or letters anywhere.
Composition: ONE complete isolated bust, nearly front-facing with a subtle three-quarter view, camera only about 12 degrees above shelf level. Portrait canvas approximately 2:3. Centered horizontally, fill the canvas tightly with the head near the top and flat bottom of the plinth at the very bottom edge; very little transparent padding. Keep entire bust, ears, glasses and plinth visible. Flat plinth bottom provides the shelf contact baseline. Do not add an actual shelf, table or floor.
Light: soft diffuse upper-left light, strong enough modeling to keep a face recognizable when reduced to 180-240 pixels tall; quiet museum-object style, not shiny or dramatic. Warm near-monochrome palette. Clean readable silhouette and gently defined edge, not a thick cartoon outline. Natural portrait proportions, not chibi.
CRITICAL: output a genuine RGBA PNG with fully TRANSPARENT alpha background around and beneath the object. No white/black background, no checkered pattern, no matte, no vignette, no cast floor shadow. Do not make a scene, photo frame, contact sheet, UI mockup, collage, or include a second ornament. Deliver only the single standalone production asset.

Preserve this recognizable sculptural portrait: long narrow face, straight nose, contemplative downcast gaze, lightly closed lips, side-parted swept hair with a low gathered back, slender neck, bare shoulders. Do not turn her into a generic young classical goddess or add spectacles.
Rematerialize this sculpture as a refined small matte warm-ivory plaster shelf ornament, with restrained carved planes, subtle soft surface texture and clearly readable medium-gray recesses. Mount it on one low, plain rectangular light-stone plinth with a beveled top edge, about 12% of total object height and just wider than the shoulders. No text, inscription or letters.
Composition: ONE complete isolated bust, nearly front-facing with a subtle three-quarter view. Change the high overhead reference camera to about 12 degrees above shelf level, with a modest view of the top surface of the plinth. Portrait canvas approximately 2:3. Center horizontally and fill tightly; head near the top and flat plinth bottom at the very bottom edge, almost no transparent padding below. Keep entire head, shoulders and plinth visible. Do not include a shelf, table or floor.
Lighting: soft diffuse upper-left light, quiet museum-object style, clear sculptural modeling that still reads at 180-240 pixels tall. Warm near-monochrome palette, matte not shiny, readable edges but no cartoon outline. Natural portrait proportions.
CRITICAL: genuine RGBA PNG with fully TRANSPARENT alpha background around the object. No opaque black/white background, checker pattern, vignette, background gradient, floor, cast floor shadow or halo. Deliver only the standalone production asset, not a scene, collage, photo frame or UI mockup.
